import scipy.optimize as opt
import time

kx, ky, kr = 0.37, 0.58, 0.15
N = 32

def simulate_packing(seed=42, steps=2000):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    # Start with small radii at random positions outside keepout
    pos = []
    while len(pos) < N:
        p = np.random.uniform(0.1, 0.9, 2)
        if np.hypot(p[0] - kx, p[1] - ky) > kr + 0.05:
            pos.append(p)
    pos = np.array(pos)
    r = np.full(N, 0.03)
    vel = np.zeros_like(pos)
    
    dt = 0.01
    damping = 0.85
    
    for step in range(steps):
        # Grow radii slightly
        r += 0.0001
        
        # Calculate forces
        forces = np.zeros_like(pos)
        
        # Wall repulsions
        # x walls
        dl = pos[:, 0] - r
        mask_l = dl < 0
        forces[mask_l, 0] -= dl[mask_l] * 50.0
        
        dr = 1.0 - (pos[:, 0] + r)
        mask_r = dr < 0
        forces[mask_r, 0] += dr[mask_r] * 50.0
        
        # y walls
        db = pos[:, 1] - r
        mask_b = db < 0
        forces[mask_b, 1] -= db[mask_b] * 50.0
        
        dt_ = 1.0 - (pos[:, 1] + r)
        mask_t = dt_ < 0
        forces[mask_t, 1] += dt_[mask_t] * 50.0
        
        # Keep-out repulsion
        d_ko = pos - np.array([kx, ky])
        dist_ko = np.hypot(d_ko[:, 0], d_ko[:, 1])
        min_dist_ko = r + kr
        overlap_ko = min_dist_ko - dist_ko
        mask_ko = overlap_ko > 0
        if np.any(mask_ko):
            unit_ko = d_ko[mask_ko] / (dist_ko[mask_ko, None] + 1e-12)
            forces[mask_ko] += unit_ko * (overlap_ko[mask_ko, None] * 50.0)
            
        # Circle-circle repulsions
        # Pairwise differences
        diff = pos[:, None, :] - pos[None, :, :] # (N, N, 2)
        dist = np.hypot(diff[:, :, 0], diff[:, :, 1]) # (N, N)
        np.fill_diagonal(dist, np.inf)
        r_sum = r[:, None] + r[None, :]
        overlap = r_sum - dist
        mask_pairs = overlap > 0
        
        if np.any(mask_pairs):
            # repulsive force along diff
            unit_diff = diff / (dist[:, :, None] + 1e-12)
            f_pairs = unit_diff * np.maximum(0, overlap)[:, :, None] * 50.0
            forces += np.sum(f_pairs, axis=1)
            
        # Update velocities and positions
        vel = vel * damping + forces * dt
        # limit velocity
        v_norm = np.hypot(vel[:, 0], vel[:, 1])
        v_max = 0.05
        vel_scale = np.where(v_norm > v_max, v_max / (v_norm + 1e-12), 1.0)
        vel = vel * vel_scale[:, None]
        
        pos += vel * dt
        
        # keep inside bounds
        pos[:, 0] = np.clip(pos[:, 0], r, 1.0 - r)
        pos[:, 1] = np.clip(pos[:, 1], r, 1.0 - r)
        
    return pos, r
